call.label: Police, fire and ambulance
call.when: Danger to life, fire, or a crime happening now
call.note: Free, including from a mobile with no credit.

call.label: Police, not an emergency
call.when: Police reports that aren't urgent. Danger now? Call 111

call.label: Healthline
call.when: Nurse advice, any hour. Not for emergencies

call.label: National Poisons Centre
call.when: Poison advice, any hour. Collapsed? Call 111

call.label: 1737, Need to talk
call.when: Call or text to talk to a counsellor, any hour

call.label: Rescue Coordination Centre, offshore and air
call.when: Offshore boat or aircraft. In danger or near shore? Call 111
call.note: Part of Maritime NZ. Police coordinate land, near-shore and inland-water rescues.
